title: Pack about dwarves
description: A fun resource pack that replaces almost every texture and model with gnomes (dwarves). Created as a personal request for a friend, now shared with everyone who loves gnomes and silly fantasy themes. For all Minecraft version
body:
- This resource pack was originally made for a friend who asked me to replace almost everything in the game with gnomes. I added a few extra things myself.

- If you love gnomes and silly fantasy vibes — this pack is for you.

- Disclaimer: This pack was created as a joke between friends ("Let's make a dwarf pack!"). It is not intended to offend anyone. All changes were made with respect and good humor.
